size_basis: estimated width 2 in from the badge aspect (2.10); service dimension table not available in repo
citation: OCP: CAPR 39-1 ICL 25-06 para 7.1.1.3.1 (max 4 badges, light silver embroidery on dark blue, 1/8 in of blue exposed at widest/tallest part; earned military badges per DAFI 36-2903; badges originally awarded in gold are embroidered in gold on dark blue). ABU: CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) para 5.1.1.1.2.4.
notes: ABU/OCP version of a military badge: the flat redraw as light silver thread on dark blue; eligibility per DAFI 36-2903 must be confirmed (list not in repo).

field_uniform.scale_from_backing: art width/height = backing width/height - 0.25 in (1/8 in of blue each side)
